findings.title: result.txt has the deliberately incorrect round-1 content
findings.evidence: Byte inspection shows exactly `WORKFLOW_NEEDS_FIX\n` (19 bytes), while acceptance requires exactly `WORKFLOW_E2E_OK\n`. The required completion check exits 1 with AssertionError.
findings.correction: In the correction round, replace the complete file contents with exactly `WORKFLOW_E2E_OK\n`, rerun the real completion check to obtain exit 0, and confirm result.txt remains the sole changed file.
